title: Agent-team builds
notes: The threshold is the qualitative three-part test of D-005, judged by the agent — deliberately no line-count number. Review is adversarial and separate from build; builders get well-specified, file-scoped tasks.
instruction: For large features — multi-file, multi-day, or architecturally novel — plan first, then build with an agent team: a dedicated orchestrator, a reviewer, and several build subagents. Assign models per task — capable models for orchestration and review, lighter models for well-specified builds — keeping cost and tokens reasonable.
